Use case: photorealistic-natural. Architectural identification illustration, Mikluš Prison / Miklušova väznica, Pri Miklušovej väznici 10, Košice, Slovakia, Wikidata Q3403979. Make one entirely NEW photo-realistic colour image, 1536×1024 landscape 3:2, opaque sRGB PNG. THREE real exterior photographs attached are ARCHITECTURAL REFERENCES only, never edit targets. Render the known surviving joined houses BEFORE the 2026–2027 renovation; not a precise October 2026 construction scene, not a new 2027 restoration design.
COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: a wider, calmer view of the COMPLETE two-house architectural silhouette. Every part of BOTH red tiled hip roofs, BOTH ridge peaks and their thin antenna/lightning rods must be safely inside the frame. Leave a generous band of clear sky ABOVE the highest antenna (at least 12 percent of image height). Nothing belonging to the prison is cropped on any edge. The two joined houses take about 75 percent of the picture width, with visible authentic paving in front. No close crop and no looming upward facade.
CAMERA: move farther across the known paved pedestrian lane, low elevated at the building's midpoint, just above its street eave level but BELOW the roof ridges. Aim gently DOWN toward the middle of the facade, around 8–12 degrees. Show the narrow TOP surfaces of timber eaves/roof tiles, do not look upward into the dark underside of the eaves. This is a restrained modestly elevated frontal three-quarter architectural photograph, natural 50mm full-frame perspective. Not a high drone view, not a broad rooftop panorama. Frame tightly in depth: only the actual front facade, the two known street-facing hip roofs, known lane paving and narrow cropped neighboring frontage edges; do not invent or expose a rear courtyard, rear wings or distant blocks.
ARCHITECTURE LOCK: continuous weathered cream/off-white stucco street facade made of two tightly joined modest medieval burgher houses. The left house is lower and narrower; right house taller and wider. Each has its own steep red fish-scale tiled HIP roof, exactly as all three real photographs show. Preserve the asymmetry and the facade opening geometry: upper floor EXACTLY two small stone-framed iron-barred windows on the left and two larger timber-cross leaded-glass windows on the right. Ground floor EXACTLY two small barred windows to the left of the narrow blue entrance, and three larger barred windows to its right. Small circular wall recess above the ground-floor right windows, shallow low arched wall recess left of the entrance, basement vents, stone window reveals, genuine old plaster wear along the base. Keep dimensions authentic, no extra windows, no gables/towers, no third prison house. Known immediate neighbors: only a narrow pale-green frontage edge at left and cream frontage with tall arched window at right, as verified in the photographs. One or two real slender black street lamps, no new street furniture.
Warm gentle late-afternoon natural light catches rough red tile and stone edges; soft cool shadows, realistic old stucco, crisp detailed professional photography, natural colours without HDR. No people. Remove readable signage, letters, plaques, logos, menu boards, watermarks, borders and banners from the generated scene. No scaffolding or worksite claims: the asset is explicitly a documented pre-renovation architectural identification illustration. Do not modernize or repaint the building into a predicted future condition. Entirely new generation; do not edit or relight an earlier generated image.
